symptom: `mxcli theme create` lists `theme/web/custom-variables.scss` and `theme/web/main.scss` as `created`, on a project that has hand-written versions of both. Nothing was touched
cause: The reported paths were relative to the scaffold, not to the project, so they collided exactly with the app paths — printed by the one command whose whole purpose is to write into `theme/`
file: `cmd/mxcli/theme/create.go` (`CreateResult.Files` carries scaffold-root-relative paths), `cmd/mxcli/cmd_theme.go` (prints them under the scaffold root)
insight: **A path in output is a claim about a location.** Two files in different trees sharing a relative path means the output has to carry the root or it asserts the wrong one. `theme.json` sits at the scaffold root and everything else under `files/`, so the result carries that distinction rather than the printer re-deriving it. ako/mxcli-ledger #139
